H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H2363: to hurry; figuratively, to be eager with excitement or enjoyment
H954: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H2659: to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H5472: properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize)
H268: the hinder part; hence (adverb) behind, backward; also (as facing north) the West
H3637: properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H6118: a heel, i.e. (figuratively) the last of anything (used adverbially, for ever); also result, i.e. compensation; and so (adverb with preposition or relatively) on account of
H1322: shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H8548: properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice
H1431: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H3444: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity
H6403: to slip out, i.e. escape; causatively, to deliver
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H309: to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate
